about: Cases of the placeholder speaker rule (src/studio/speaker_view.py, static/js/studio/speaker-view.js): the speakers of a transcript's segments, and whether their label is hidden. Both implementations are tested against this file.

cases.why: another form of the same kind of label
segments without a speaker do not count
two labels: a transcriber that tells voices apart
a named speaker beside the placeholder
no speaker at all: nothing to hide
